message.content:
This editorial illustration features a teal-colored magazine cover with a vertical red band on the left edge. At the top, the black serif word "TEMPO" is centered above the date "1-7 JUNI 2015." Above this title are the words "PUTUSAN BANAL PRAPERADILAN HADI POERNOMO" on the left and "GENG PEMBUNUH JOPI PERANGINANGIN" on the right.

The central graphic depicts a dark, stylized landscape submerged in water. A large, dark spoon-like shape scoops an island covered in green foliage out of the sea. Light beams from above illuminate the island, which is flanked by small white sailboats. To the right, a silhouette of a city skyline is visible on the horizon.

Below the spoon, large white sans-serif text reads "PASIR ILEGAL DI TELUK JAKARTA." Smaller white text underneath states, "Reklamasi pulau diduga menggunakan pasir curian. Perusahaan raksasa properti ditengarai terlibat." At the bottom right, a barcode and pricing information are visible, including "RP 39.500," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126-4273."
